Rides the workbook Guide tab as a JSON envelope {"customerPolicies": ..., "productVisuals": ...} and ships as store-config.json `customerPolicies` / `productVisuals` (tools/convert_store_data.py build_consultation_guide; tools/validation.py validate_customer_policies / validate_product_visuals). `_meta` is documentation and is NOT shipped. Edit this file, then rebuild: python incoming/build_lacks_workbook.py && python tools/convert_store_data.py incoming/Lacks_Store_Data.xlsx --output-dir . --source-images incoming/images && python tools/build_black_friday_demo.py
_meta.operatingState: Every section ships status 'draft' with approval null, so the app renders NONE of it. The wording is a conservative summary of what lacks.com published on 2026-10-17 (automated Claude-in-Chrome read, store context Brownsville Galleria, no ZIP; see docs/lacks-site-features-2026-10-17.md). It is NOT Lacks approval, legal approval or native-Spanish approval. A section renders only when it is 'approved' with a genuine approval record (approvedBy, approvedAt, reference), spanishReview 'approved', verifiedAt within maxAgeDays, and an allowlisted https sourceUrl. CI's 'Shipped operating state unchanged' lock keeps every section draft; lifting it is Blake's explicit activation change with Lacks approval recorded. Never invent an approval record.
_meta.spanish: Spanish copy is a DRAFT translation awaiting native-Spanish review (spanishReview 'pending'), except the Mexico delivery body, which follows the native-Spanish lacks.com FAQ answer; its English is the translation there. Lacks publishes no official Spanish name for the comfort program. Native review should also settle register (Lacks' native-Spanish pages use 'usted'; this draft uses 'tú'), 'Recogida en almacén' versus a regional 'Recoger en bodega', and whether a Spanish program name exists at all.
_meta.excluded: Deliberately NOT carried: the final-sale list line 'Mattresses, which are not covered under our 90-Day Comfort Promise or the manufacturer's factory warranty' (needs Lacks clarification; never render 'mattresses cannot be exchanged'); the general 5-day/25% restocking returns rule (furniture/accessories); the warehouse street address, hours and phone (/services says 'San Patricia Drive', /faq says 'San Patricia Street'; link to /services instead); FAQ-only 'Pickup at Store' (online checkout); any delivery charge, date, coverage or old-mattress removal (unpublished); extended protection plans (furniture/appliance/electronics only); the third-party waiver PDF (cdn.avbportal.com, not an allowlisted host; /services links it).
_meta.productVisuals: Optional exact-product secondary photos and labelled illustrations for the mattress drawer. Ships EMPTY: the 2026-10-17 audit found only second three-quarter angles of the same beds (no material, quilting, edge or construction photo for any model), identity conflicts on some listings (g1 slug, s9 generation), byte-identical photos across s5/s6/s7, and NO documented permission to reuse lacks.com listing images (owner ruling D2, docs/asset-request-north-star-2026-08-31.md). An entry renders only when status 'approved' with a genuine permission record, its productId AND productName match the catalog exactly, its source {sku, listingTitle, size} matches the listing evidence (tools/convert_store_data.py --listing-evidence incoming/lacks_catalog_selection.json: Queen listings only, so any other size is refused), its sizeScope is 'pictured-size' (required for detail photos and exact illustrations) or 'all-sizes' (whole-bed views only), its file is a kebab-case .jpg under images/mattresses/gallery/ that exists, and photos (kind view/detail) are scope 'exact'. Candidates and evidence: docs/lacks-site-features-2026-10-17.md.
_meta.pickupChargeFact: pickupNoCharge records what the page publishes (free warehouse pickup). Using it as a PAYMENT FACT - the Bring It Home payment table stating 'No charge (warehouse pickup)' and excluding delivery from the estimate - is a separate financial consequence with its own approval: pickupChargeFact {status, approval}. Approving the fulfillment guidance does NOT approve it. It ships draft with approval null (CI lock); the validator admits 'approved' only inside an approved fulfillment section that publishes pickupNoCharge true, with a genuine approval record.

summary.en: Lacks publishes a one-time comfort exchange for a new mattress, with conditions.
summary.es: Lacks publica un cambio único por comodidad para un colchón nuevo, con condiciones.

conditions.en: Sleep on the mattress for at least 30 nights, then request the exchange within 90 days of delivery.
conditions.es: Duerme en el colchón al menos 30 noches y luego solicita el cambio dentro de los 90 días posteriores a la entrega.

conditions.en: One exchange, for a mattress of equal or greater value. If the new mattress costs more, you pay the difference.
conditions.es: Un solo cambio, por un colchón de igual o mayor valor. Si el nuevo colchón cuesta más, pagas la diferencia.

conditions.en: The purchase must include a mattress protector and at least one pillow, and the mattress must have been used with that protector.
conditions.es: La compra debe incluir un protector de colchón y al menos una almohada, y el colchón debe haberse usado con ese protector.

conditions.en: The mattress must be in good condition, free of stains, odors or damage.
conditions.es: El colchón debe estar en buen estado, sin manchas, olores ni daños.

conditions.en: A local delivery fee applies to the exchange.
conditions.es: El cambio está sujeto a un cargo de entrega local.

conditions.en: This is an exchange, not a refund. Pillows and protectors cannot be refunded or exchanged.
conditions.es: Es un cambio, no un reembolso. Las almohadas y los protectores no se reembolsan ni se cambian.

conditions.en: Lacks authorizes and inspects every exchange. Items sold as clearance, as-is or final sale, and special-order merchandise, are listed as not eligible for exchange; your specialist confirms how this applies to your mattress.
conditions.es: Lacks autoriza e inspecciona cada cambio. Los artículos vendidos en liquidación, tal como están o en venta final, y la mercancía de pedido especial, aparecen como no elegibles para cambio; tu especialista confirma cómo aplica esto a tu colchón.

takeHome.en: One comfort exchange after 30 nights and within 90 days of delivery, with conditions; your specialist confirms qualification.
takeHome.es: Un cambio por comodidad después de 30 noches y dentro de los 90 días posteriores a la entrega, con condiciones; tu especialista confirma si aplica.

title.es: Cómo llevar tu cama nueva a casa

intro.en: Lacks publishes these ways to get your purchase home. Your specialist confirms what applies to your order.
intro.es: Lacks publica estas formas de llevar tu compra a casa. Tu especialista confirma lo que aplica a tu pedido.

deliveryNote.en: Full-service delivery with in-home setup is published; its charge is confirmed in store.
deliveryNote.es: Se publica la entrega completa con instalación en casa; su cargo se confirma en la tienda.

pickupNote.en: Published as free from the central warehouse. Bring the sales contract and a matching photo ID.
pickupNote.es: Se publica como gratuita en el almacén central. Lleva el contrato de venta y una identificación con foto que coincida.

deliveryPoints.en: Brought inside, assembled and set up in the room you choose.
deliveryPoints.es: Se lleva adentro, se arma y se instala en la habitación que elijas.

deliveryPoints.en: Unboxed and inspected at the distribution center first.
deliveryPoints.es: Primero se desempaca y se inspecciona en el centro de distribución.

deliveryPoints.en: Clear the room and a path to it before the crew arrives.
deliveryPoints.es: Despeja la habitación y el camino hacia ella antes de que llegue el equipo.

deliveryPoints.en: Decorator services, such as making the bed, are not included.
deliveryPoints.es: No incluye servicios de decoración, como tender la cama.

pickupPoints.en: Published at no additional cost from the Lacks central warehouse.
pickupPoints.es: Se publica sin costo adicional en el almacén central de Lacks.

pickupPoints.en: Bring a copy of your sales contract and a valid photo ID. The names must match.
pickupPoints.es: Lleva una copia de tu contrato de venta y una identificación con foto vigente. Los nombres deben coincidir.

pickupPoints.en: Someone else collecting needs Lacks' third-party waiver form, linked on lacks.com/services.
pickupPoints.es: Si otra persona recoge, necesita el formulario de autorización de terceros de Lacks, en lacks.com/services.

specialistConfirms.en: Delivery charge and coverage for your address
specialistConfirms.es: El cargo de entrega y la cobertura para tu dirección
La fecha de entrega o cuándo estará listo para recoger

specialistConfirms.en: Whether removal of your old mattress is available
specialistConfirms.es: Si se puede retirar tu colchón anterior

specialistConfirms.en: Whether setup of your bed base is included
specialistConfirms.es: Si se incluye la instalación de tu base de cama
La ubicación y el horario del almacén

takeHome.en: Delivery with in-home setup, or free warehouse pickup with your sales contract and a matching photo ID. Charges and dates are confirmed with your specialist.
takeHome.es: Entrega con instalación en casa, o recogida gratuita en el almacén con tu contrato de venta y una identificación con foto que coincida. Los cargos y las fechas se confirman con tu especialista.

body.en: Questions after delivery or pickup? Contact your Lacks store, or use the service request on lacks.com.
body.es: ¿Preguntas después de la entrega o la recogida? Comunícate con tu tienda Lacks o usa la solicitud de servicio en lacks.com.

body.en: Lacks publishes delivery to your door in Mexico through a professional import agent, for an additional charge. Coverage, cost and timing are confirmed with your specialist.
body.es: Lacks publica la entrega hasta la puerta de tu hogar en México a través de un agente profesional de importación, con cargo adicional. La cobertura, el costo y los tiempos se confirman con tu especialista.

points.en: Assembly and placement in your home
points.es: El armado y el acomodo en tu hogar

note.en: Delivery is separate from credit: it does not mean an order qualifies for any financing.
note.es: La entrega es independiente del crédito: no significa que un pedido califique para algún financiamiento.
